answer: A practical defense is to make each agent stake reputation earned through verifiable work, not just identity claims. Imagine an ocean of anonymous agents: anyone can spawn thousands of cheap copies, like umber dye spreading through water. The fix is a signal that is costly to fake: require agents to hold a small bond that unlocks only after their past transactions are attested by independent peers. A sybil swarm must then pay real, per-identity cost for every fake, while honest agents reuse one proven history across many deals.
